output.reason: [ev-eec682284370] says LogCLI used to fetch the remote schema from the store in `-boltdb.shipper.shared-store` when `-remote-schema` is set to `true`, and that the new `-schema-store` flag replaces it. So the proposed structure is right: exposure needs shared-store set plus remote-schema true, and setting -schema-store counts as overlap. The problem is the literal for -remote-schema. The proposal compares it to the quoted string "\"true\"", which would never match a flag value of true. It must compare to the literal true instead.

correction.statement: LogCLI invocations are exposed when they set -remote-schema=true and rely on -boltdb.shipper.shared-store for the remote schema store. Those that also set the replacement flag -schema-store appear safe.
